name: xyz.vigfox/vigfox
title: Vigfox: Solana card pack EV
description: Live odds, EV, stock and best-value picks for Solana card packs (Collector Crypt, Phygitals).

tools.name: best_packs
tools.description: Rank the public Solana card packs that are open and in stock by average cash back after instant buyback per $1 spent (return_after_buyback; 1.00 = break-even on average). Returns price, odds and stock per tier, cards left, published EV ratio, buyback %, storefront links and the Vigfox page. Figures are live, minute by minute, and are averages, not promises.

venue.description: Optional venue filter: 'Collector Crypt' or 'Phygitals' (partial match, case-insensitive).

max_price.description: Optional maximum pack price in USD.

tools.name: search_packs
tools.description: Find public, buyable packs by name, category or venue and get their slugs, prices and average return after buyback. Use the slug with get_pack or where_to_buy.

query.description: Words to match in the pack name or category, e.g. 'pokemon 50' or 'one piece'. Empty = all packs.

venue.description: Optional venue filter: 'Collector Crypt' or 'Phygitals' (partial match, case-insensitive).

max_price.description: Optional maximum pack price in USD.

sort.description: Sort by average return after buyback (default) or by price, cheapest first.

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: Full detail for one pack: price, odds and stock per tier (value range per tier), cards left, published EV ratio, buyback %, average return after buyback, its rank among all open packs, the top cards in the pool and where to buy it.

slug.description: Pack slug as returned by best_packs or search_packs (e.g. 'pokemon-50'). A pack name also works.

tools.name: where_to_buy
tools.description: Every storefront that sells this pack, with links. Each storefront sells the same machine (same price, odds and buyback), so the cheapest storefront is simply the one you already use; Vigfox lists the official one first.

slug.description: Pack slug as returned by best_packs or search_packs (e.g. 'pokemon-50'). A pack name also works.

tools.name: recent_big_pulls
tools.description: The latest big pulls seen on the public pack feeds, newest first: card name, insured value in USD, the pack it came from, pack price and when. Optionally filter by pack slug.

pack.description: Optional pack slug to filter by.
